market: small businesses that keep their own books and want less admin
problem: back-office administration takes time away from actually running the business
product: software that reduces the routine bookkeeping work its users do by hand
revenue_model: a recurring subscription paid by the businesses that use it
acquisition_channel: online channels, word of mouth and referrals
workflow: understand the need, build something useful, put it in front of customers
model_policy: prefer local models for drafting; escalate only for customer-facing text
